name: Accessibility & Sensory Verification Rig
description: Deterministic contract verifying WCAG 2.1 AA modal focus trap, sound caption HUD, and Python AST syntax safety

assertions.description: Focus trap functionality and aria-modal are implemented
Accessible aria-live region is configured for sound captions

steps.name: Verify Python AST Compatibility & Syntax Safety
steps.command: python3 -c "import ast, os; [ast.parse(open(os.path.join(r, f)).read()) for r, _, fs in os.walk('src') for f in fs if f.endswith('.py')]; print('AST OK')"

assertions.description: All Python source files pass strict AST syntax parsing
AST parsing confirms zero syntax or f-string errors
